viewportMatrix.expectation: main region remains at least seventy percent and the right drawer defaults closed
left navigation main region and right drawer remain usable without obscuring the current context
evidence and task views may be placed side by side while preserving reading order

invariants: stale and partial may preserve only explicitly labelled prior content with a data cutoff
failed forbidden and blocked use alert semantics and never inject sample data
unknown is not converted to empty failed zero or ready
blocked controls remain focusable and expose a stable reason code and recovery action
ready proves only the capability represented by the current canonical response and never implies all agents providers actions or modules are operational

keyboardAndAccessibilityMatrix: exactly one page-level H1 and stable main navigation and content landmarks
skip link moves focus to the module main region
current installed module has exactly one aria-current page marker
tablist tab and tabpanel use role aria-selected aria-controls and roving tabindex
ArrowLeft ArrowRight ArrowUp ArrowDown Home End Enter Space Tab Shift-Tab and Escape follow the component interaction contract
dialogs and drawers place initial focus on the summary and restore focus to the trigger after close
navigation collapse focus mode retry and manual takeover preserve or restore a visible focus target
status alert and asynchronous updates are exposed through appropriate live regions
status meaning is not color-only and icons have text equivalents
two hundred percent zoom and keyboard use do not hide required actions or trap focus
prefers-reduced-motion removes nonessential transitions and animations
charts expose a text summary or table and exact cutoff assumptions and unknown values
browserEvidenceContract: run a production build through formal HTTP rather than file URLs or static mockups
record the exact bundle installation module and API revisions plus tenant and data cutoff
for every module viewport and state assert DOM semantics keyboard path visible focus network response and console errors
use org-org/dev-project only for positive evidence and dev-org/dev-project only for isolation canary
capture refresh deep-link tenant-switch stale response and late response rejection
keep screenshot DOM network console authority and Receipt evidence in one immutable EvidencePack
a blocked or failed-close page is valid negative evidence but never positive feature completion
